verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows can automate decisions across many inquiries and Reports can be scheduled to run repeatedly against accounts, giving some automation-depth, but there is no documented bulk/batch API endpoint for creating, verifying, or processing many items in a single call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-create/batch-verify endpoints, evidence of processing multiple accounts/inquiries in one request, and any bulk export or batch report generation across many items.
